Don't forget that this is 360 video: you can change the angle of view. 

This stunning cascade of waterfalls is located on the border between the United States and Canada, separating the states of New York and the province of Ontario. Imagine: tons of water crashing down from a height of 57 meters, creating an impressive spectacle that can be observed from both sides of the border.
